objectives.name: Kidney disease detection and inequalities
objectives.details: Use linked pseudonymised renal, primary care and hospital data to investigate whether people with evidence of chronic kidney disease in routinely collected clinical data are appropriately identified, recorded and referred for care. Initial work could identify patients meeting clinical or laboratory criteria for CKD who are missing from disease registers or specialist pathways, quantify the scale of any detection or referral gap, and examine inequalities by demographic, socioeconomic, geographic and clinical characteristics. The linked data could also support broader studies of CKD pathways, outcomes and variation in care. Free-text renal records are additionally available, creating opportunities for NLP or LLM-based methods where these add value.
